INSERT INTO chat_model_latency
               (model, provider, recorded_at, ttft_ms, decode_ms, output_tokens, prompt_tokens)
           SELECT $1, $2,
                  now() - make_interval(hours => i * 4),
                  600 + (i * 137) % 1400,
                  300 + (i * 89) % 500,
                  (300 + (i * 89) % 500) * (1800 + (i * 53) % 700) / 1000,
                  4000 + (i * 311) % 6000
           FROM generate_series(1, 40) AS i
           RETURNING id
